content:
“One more mile!”

**All Night Long** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased duration of alcohol's positive effects.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | The positive effects of pre-war alcohol last twice as long. | 00393F51 | 

- Update 56 reduced ranks from 3 to 1 and changed the cost of the first rank to 2. Before this change All Night Long reduced hunger and thirst growth by 20%/40%/60% at night.
- Before Update 4 the perk reduced the suffering from hunger and thirst by 20%/40%/60%.

There are other alcohol related perks in the game:

- Professional Drinker - prevents alcohol addictions
- Happy-Go-Lucky - increases Luck while under the influence of alcohol

Other perks that increase duration of consumables include:

- Chem Fiend - chems
- Secret Agent - Stealth Boys
- Curator - Bobbleheads and magazines
